'''Open (100 cards)''' is a constructed format on [[GEMP]] (code <code>open_100_card</code>). It uses the same card pool as [[Open]], with a deck size of 100 cards and a default game timer of 90 minutes. Its format definition links to the Players Committee 100 Card Deck Format page and marks it as not a game hall format.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib" /> On play.swccg.com it is no longer a separate format. Since 3 November 2026, a table, league or tournament there plays [[Open]] with the deck size game option set to 100 cards, and the old code still loads that way, with the same 90-minute timer and tenets link.<ref name="gemp-setup">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/e0fb37f23b6d81b7a3a248127d78466601cb6be4/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/swccgFormats.json swccgFormats.json], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit e0fb37f2), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261103212934/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/e0fb37f2/swccgFormats.json.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="gemp-options">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/e0fb37f23b6d81b7a3a248127d78466601cb6be4/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/game/setup/GameOptions.java GameOptions.java], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit e0fb37f2), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261103212856/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/e0fb37f2/GameOptions.java.html Internet Archive].</ref> The card pool is Decipher-printed set ids 1&ndash;14 ([[Premiere]] through [[Theed Palace]]) and premium ids 101&ndash;112. It also includes current Virtual Sets 0&ndash;27 (ids 200&ndash;227) and the Virtual Premium Set (id 301).<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" />

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 100 cards
|}
The GEMP format definition sets a deck size of 100 cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib" />

On play.swccg.com, deck size is a game option chosen when a table, league or tournament is set up, separate from the format. Any format can be played at any supported size (40 to 100 cards as of November 2026). Games show the chosen size next to the format name, for example "Open · 100 cards".<ref name="gemp-options" /><ref name="gemp-setup" />

== Players Committee page ==
The Players Committee describes the 100 Card Deck Format as a special format with 100 cards per deck. The per-player game timer is 90 minutes, instead of the 60 minutes of the usual 60-card format. The page says online play of the format on GEMP has been suspended indefinitely because of performance issues.<ref name="pc-100card" />
